# Join the Multicraft Server

This page will help you join our remote Multicraft world.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 1 — Install the app

### [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/multicraft-build-and-mine/id1174039276)

### [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multicraft.game&hl=en)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Step 2 — Join the server

Open the Multicraft app and:

-   Tap **"Multiplayer"**
-   Copy the server address below and paste it into **"Invite Code"**

``` md
206-12-122-94.cloud.computecanada.ca:30000
```

-   Choose a name for your player
-   Choose a password
-   Tap **Play**
-   You will be prompted to connect to the server then re-enter your password
-   Wait for the game assets to download to your device before you can play

------------------------------------------------------------------------
